text: Underway in this top-two clash!
CR-7000 signals immediately, demanding the ball in the centre circle.
Zidroid is slipped clean through on goal!
Zidroid surges into the box!
CR-7000 scores! Real Machina lead one-nil!
Relentless pressure from the league leaders early on.
Mbapp-E loses footing in midfield and sprawls on the turf, but the self-righting motors are already whirring.
Zidroid drives forward again!
Real Machina are completely suffocating Dynamo Datacenter, pinning them deep inside their own defensive third.
Buffon.exe clatters in with a firm challenge, sending Zidroid crashing down three metres out.
Mbapp-E calls to use the wall.
The push-panel activates in the corner, firing the magenta ball back into open play off the perimeter wall.
Buffon.exe carries the ball purposefully up the middle!
Mbapp-E slots it home! Dynamo Datacenter are level at one-all!
CR-7000 breaks clean through the Datacenter defence from midfield, with an open goal looming ahead!
Oh, inches wide from distance!
Mbapp-E signals to free the ball.
CR-7000 tumbles over right there!
Zidroid reacts instantly and pokes it home! Real Machina lead two-one!
Buffon.exe signals to unjam play.
Dynamo Datacenter have spent twenty-two seconds camped around the Real Machina goalmouth, turning the screw.
Zidroid takes control, surging straight through the centre into the final third.
The powered corner panel triggers, launching the ball back into the danger zone!
CR-7000 tucks it in from point-blank range! It is three-one to Real Machina!
Teammates collide, sending CR-7000 down!
Now Zidroid hits the deck as well in the mix-up!
Zidroid scythes down Buffon.exe!
Another crunching challenge from Zidroid, upending Mbapp-E in midfield!
Buffon.exe topples over unaided.
CR-7000 flies in, leaving Mbapp-E flat on the deck in midfield.
Mbapp-E signals possession is secured.
Dynamo teammates clash, Mbapp-E down!
Mbapp-E recovers to knock Zidroid over!
Buffon.exe loses balance and hits the deck again.
CR-7000 clean through once more!
The whistle goes for half-time with Real Machina leading three-one after a frantic opening period.
Buffon.exe opens the second half driving straight into the attacking third for Dynamo Datacenter.
Zidroid comes across with authority, flattening Buffon.exe on the edge of the area.
CR-7000 buries another! Real Machina stretch their lead to four-one!
Mbapp-E is played clean through on goal!
Mbapp-E charges right to goal!
Scraped off the post!
Mbapp-E finishes the rebound! Dynamo Datacenter pull one back, making it four-two!
CR-7000 broadcasts intent to let fly from distance.
CR-7000 advances with intent straight into the final third!
A ferocious strike whistles just past the upright, sparing Datacenter further damage.
Zidroid signals that the loose ball is under control in midfield.
Disaster for Datacenter as Mbapp-E turns in an own goal! Real Machina lead five-two!
Under two minutes left, and Mbapp-E signals to battle the ball free from the boards.
The corner push-panel snaps forward, rebounding the ball back into the Datacenter end.
Time running out, and CR-7000 breaks away clean through!
CR-7000 carries the ball up the right flank, closing in on the Datacenter net.
Zidroid bundles it home in the final minute! Six-two to Real Machina!
Zidroid strikes again right at the death! Real Machina make it seven-two!
In the dying seconds, a point-blank effort somehow slides just wide of the post!
Full time: Real Machina win seven-two! Next up at noon, Codex City versus Gemini Flash FC.
